messages.subject: knitr_expand and string {{parameter}}
parts:
Hello,

I don't manage to use knitr_expand, and I'm a quite new at R and knitr. I want to repeat the same analysis for several regions (esc). Below I tried to show a simple version of it.


=== parent Rmd file ===

```{r EscReport, echo=TRUE}
library(knitr)
library(scales)
library(ggplot2)

Supplies3 <- expand.grid(Region = factor(c("Reg1", "Reg2", "Reg3")), Product = c("Prod1", "Prod2"), Cut=c("BP", "FC1"))
Supplies3 <- cbind(Supplies3,Volume=rnorm(12, mean = 100, sd = 25))
ESCs <- as.vector(levels(Supplies3$Region))
src <- lapply(ESCs, function(esc) knit_expand(file = "TestTemplate.Rmd"))
knit(text = unlist(src))

```

=== TestTemplate.Rmd ===

```{r chunk1-{{esc}}, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df1 <- Supplies3[Supplies3$Region=={{esc}},]
#df1 <- {{Supplies3[Supplies3$Region==esc,]}} was also attempted, among others
c1 <- ggplot(df1,aes(x = Cut, y = Volume)) + geom_bar( stat = "identity") + labs(title = paste({{esc}},", Volume per product","")) + facet_wrap( ~ Product)
```

```{r  fig1-{{esc}}, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=4,dpi=144}
print(c1)
```

====
